security_audit.summary: All 30 static detections are false positives caused by Markdown inline code, fenced prompt examples, documentation links, and informational URLs. The skill directs the agent to treat external content as untrusted, requires user confirmation before saving, and does not contain executable shell commands or path construction from untrusted input. No prompt-injection, data-exfiltration, or other semantic security issue was identified.

remediation.issue: Static scanners misclassify Markdown backticks as shell execution.
remediation.suggestion: Use code-fence language labels and avoid shell-like inline syntax where possible to reduce false positives.

remediation.issue: Static scanners flag relative documentation links as path traversal.
remediation.suggestion: Keep cross-skill references as documentation-only links and consider a manifest-based reference format for scanner compatibility.

content.value_statement: Paid campaigns need varied copy that matches the landing page and follows format limits. This skill creates structured creative sets with clear claim and message-match checks.
actual_capabilities: Generates RSA headlines and descriptions for a specified offer and destination page.
Builds angle matrices with distinct angles, hooks, and creative variants.
Adapts copy to the requested platform, format, audience, and brand voice.
Annotates units with the destination claim they match.
Flags unsupported, restricted, or unsubstantiated claims for review.
Prepares a handoff summary and can save a draft after user confirmation.
limitations: It does not upload, activate, or manage advertising accounts.
It needs an offer, destination URL, platform, and audience to enforce message matching.
It cannot verify live platform policy changes or the truth of supplied claims.
It produces draft creative that requires human legal, brand, and policy review.

use_cases.title: Launch search campaign variants
use_cases.description: Create RSA headlines and descriptions that match a product landing page.

use_cases.title: Plan social creative tests
use_cases.description: Build a matrix of angles and hooks for structured creative experiments.

use_cases.title: Refresh weak ad copy
use_cases.description: Keep successful concepts and propose replacements for losing headlines.

prompt_templates.title: Generate basic RSA copy
prompt_templates.prompt: Generate 15 RSA headlines and 4 descriptions for [offer]. The destination URL is [URL]. The platform is Google Ads.

prompt_templates.title: Build an angle matrix
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a 3 by 3 angle matrix for [offer] on [platform]. Use [URL] for message matching. The audience is [audience].

prompt_templates.title: Refresh existing creative
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these losing headlines: [paste]. Keep the successful theme, replace weak variants, and match every unit to [URL].

prompt_templates.title: Create a compliant test package
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a campaign test package for [offer] on [platform]. Use [URL], [audience], and [brand voice]. Flag every claim requiring substantiation and provide message-match notes.

output_examples.input: Generate RSA copy for a project management tool aimed at small agencies.
output: A message-match note for each claim-bearing unit

output_examples.input: Build a social angle matrix for a fitness app launch.
output: Claim and policy review flags for human review

best_practices: Provide the current landing page, offer details, audience, and target platform.
Review every factual claim against approved evidence before publishing.
Test distinct angles while keeping the destination message consistent.
anti_patterns: Do not use the skill to upload or activate ads without separate approval and tooling.
Do not ask it to invent prices, results, testimonials, or guarantees.
Do not publish drafts without checking current platform policies and legal requirements.

faq.question: Which ad formats can it support?
faq.answer: It supports RSA copy, hooks, and angle matrices, using the supplied platform and format requirements.

faq.question: Does it publish ads?
faq.answer: No. It creates draft creative and does not upload or activate advertising campaigns.

faq.question: What information should I provide?
faq.answer: Provide the offer, destination URL, platform, audience, brand voice, and any approved claims.

faq.question: Can it analyze existing ad performance?
faq.answer: It can use user-provided exports to inform variants, but it does not score an entire ad account.

faq.question: How does it handle unsupported claims?
faq.answer: It flags them for evidence review rather than presenting them as publish-ready copy.

faq.question: Can it research competitor ads?
faq.answer: It can use manually supplied or publicly observed examples for angle research, but it should not copy competitor creative.
